definitions.explanation: a train car or vehicle designated as smoke-free

examples.japanese: {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'd like a seat in the non-smoking car, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全車両|ぜんしゃりょう}{禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}です。
examples.english: All cars on this train are non-smoking.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}→喫煙車：29946_kitsuensha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれていた→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全面|ぜんめん}→全面：22735_zenmen⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧だ。
examples.english: Trains used to be split between smoking and non-smoking cars, but now almost all trains are entirely smoke-free.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧ (no smoking) and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (car/vehicle). Historically, Japanese trains had separate ⟦{喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}→喫煙車：29946_kitsuensha⟧ (smoking cars) and {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ} (non-smoking cars). As of the 2020s, almost all trains in Japan are entirely non-smoking, making the distinction largely historical. The term is still used when booking Shinkansen seats, as some older reservation systems reference it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧: reserved seat in a non-smoking car
- {全車|ぜんしゃ}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: all cars non-smoking
- {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to request a non-smoking car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}→喫煙車：29946_kitsuensha⟧: smoking car — the opposite, now largely discontinued
- ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}{席|せき}→禁煙席：09694_kinenseki⟧: non-smoking seat — used in restaurants and planes
- ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking — the general concept or policy
